toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Its table of contents (line 9) lists 13 sections and omits five later top-level sections.

units.does: no behavioural claim: document title plus pointers to API_REFERENCE.md, FLOWCHART.md, USERS_MANUAL.md and FLO_ARCHITECTURE.md (AI module moved there).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Table of Contents

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for recording architecture.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Hybrid Recording Strategy
units.does: Claims session-first flow; overnight H10 uses strap internal recording as primary with BLE streaming as backup and composite gap-fill; Verity Sense uses offline PPI recording plus online PPI streaming, rejects PPI samples with error estimate >20 ms, and auto-disconnects after a session. Code matches: StrapPPIFilter.acceptedInterval rejects blockerBit!=0 or ppErrorEstimate>20 (maxErrorEstimateMs=20) and out-of-300..2000 ms; offline PPI start/fetch live in StrapRecordingCoordinator; Verity disconnect after quick and overnight sessions.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Data Source Selection
units.does: Claims DataSourceSelector prefers internal recording, builds a composite when internal has >5% fewer beats than streaming, uses streaming when internal failed or composite cannot be built, and that a source needs >=120 beats (minimumValidBeats). Code matches: minimumValidBeats=120 (DataSourceSelector.swift:7), compositeThresholdPercent=5.0 with percent computed against max(count) and only when internal<streaming (:124-128), compositeOrStreaming falls back to streaming (:103-122). The RawRRBackup path (item 4) is not in DataSourceSelector; it is RRCollector+BackupRecovery.recoverFromBackup.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Composite Merging Algorithm
units.does: Claims gap detection = jump from beat end to next start > expected RR + 2 s; a gap is fillable when >=1 streaming point (by wallClockMs) falls inside; createComposite filters streaming to beats inside gaps then mergePoints interleaves with 50 ms duplicate suppression and rebases gap-fill points to wallClockMs; SessionMerger uses mergeAddingOnlyUncoveredBeats. Code matches: findGaps uses actualGap > rr_ms + 2000 (DataSourceSelector.swift:213); countFillableBeats uses wallClockMs ?? t_ms; streamingBeatsInsideGaps; mergePoints/takeEarlier/skip*Duplicates use strict < 50 ms; rebased() sets t_ms to wallClockMs; SessionMerger.swift:179/182 call mergeAddingOnlyUncoveredBeats. MorningProcessingService.createCompositePoints is a thin wrapper that re-runs selectBestSource.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Strap Link and Reconnection
units.does: Claims the strap link is event-driven via StrapLinkCoordinator with SDK callbacks serialised through StrapEventPump; StrapReadiness generations and whenFeatureUsable with StrapErrorClassifier retrying 'not ready' refusals; StrapHeartRateFeed opened on link establishment and checked by scripts/check_hr_feed_subscribes_on_link.sh; StrapFeedHealth re-subscribes first and escalates to link reset only for a recording session after 30 s and at most every 3 min; drops preserve connectedDeviceId while streaming, re-assert connect once, and wait PolarReconnectPolicy.windowSeconds (20 min) before reconnectExhausted; lost pairing ends wait at once; reconnect increments streamingReconnectCount. Code matches: StrapFeedHealth.resubscribeGraceSec=30, linkResetCooldownSec=180; PolarReconnectPolicy.windowSeconds=20*60; linkDropped -> clearLinkReadings(preserveDeviceIdentity: wasStreaming); respondToDrop -> requestReconnect + armReconnectDeadline; pairingLost sets reconnectExhausted when streaming; StrapLinkCoordinator.swift:99 increments streamingReconnectCount; the script file exists.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Pause & Resume (Split Sleep)
units.does: Claims pause stops streaming, runs full analysis, archives as .paused, shows score preview and persists state to UserDefaults; resume creates a new session whose linkedSessionIds point at the parent; combined analysis merges RR before window selection; auto-finalize only when the strap battery drops to 5% or lower while paused (bindBatteryAndReconnect -> finalizeFromPause), a disconnect while paused leaves the night paused until Done or the battery rule. Code: pauseOvernightStreaming -> pauseWithFullAnalysis (analysis + archive .paused + persistPauseAndClearRecording) or pauseWithShortRecording (no analysis, no score); resume sets linkedSessionIds=[parent]; mergeParentSessionData merges only the direct parent's beats.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Raw RR Backup Strategy
units.does: Claims initial backup writes immediately (isDue true with no previous backup), incremental every ~60 s (incrementalBackup interval default 60), forced on reconnection, stored in App Group container. Code matches: RawRRBackup.isDue returns true when lastBackup nil; incrementalBackup(interval: 60) skips unless force or due; resolveBackupDirectory uses the App Group container then Documents then temporary directory.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recording Architecture > Importing and rebuilding workouts Emuqu did not record
units.does: Claims HealthWorkoutImporter.rebuild reconstructs a crashed stub from Apple Health passive samples reusing the stub id; ActivityBoutResolver ends a bout after defaultMaxGap=10 min inactivity capped at maxBoutDuration=6 h; InterruptedRecordingCard surfaces it; candidates lists external workouts from the last 30 days excluding HKSource.default(); imported sessions carry no RR/RMSSD/DFA (rrSeries and analysisResult nil) via ImportedWorkoutBuilder; sample queries use overlap predicates while cumulative distance uses .strictStartDate. Code matches: rebuild(stub) passes replacing: stub.id; ActivityBoutResolver constants 10*60 and 6*3600; candidates(days: 30) with NOT predicateForObjects(from: HKSource.default()); ImportedWorkoutBuilder.blankSession sets rrSeries nil, analysisResult nil; cumulativeSum uses .strictStartDate (Rebuild.swift:423); quantity/window queries use options [].

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms
units.does: Claims RecoveryScoreCalculator keeps composite entry points with +Composite/+Tiers/+Training extensions; ScoringVersion.current = v3.2.oct2026; training load is not a composite tier; ReadinessScoring, VitalsScoring and ScoreDetailBuilder were split out with forwarding extensions; WindowSelection split into +Scoring (findBestWindow, selectWindowByMethod, analyzeAtPosition), +Evaluation and +Filters. Code matches: ScoringVersion.swift:37 current = "v3.2.oct2026"; all named files exist; the three functions are in WindowSelection+Scoring.swift (:83, :554, :724).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Artifact Detection
units.does: Claims rolling-median artifact detection with a centred 50-beat insertion-sorted window; technical if RR<300 or >2000 (confidence 1.0); extra if RR<median*0.5; short ectopic if RR<median*0.7 and deviation >20%; long ectopic if RR>median*1.2; missed if RR>median*1.5; minRR raised to 300 ms in Constants.swift. Code matches: HRVConstants.Artifacts.windowSize=50, RRInterval.minimum=300/maximum=2000, ArtifactDetector.Config ectopic 0.20/missed 0.50/extra 0.30; classify -> shortBeatFlags/longBeatFlags. Undocumented: a beat between 0.7 and 0.8 of the median is flagged ectopic by the generic ratio>0.20 branch (ArtifactDetection.swift:61), and in the short branch every beat below 0.7*median already has ratio>0.3 so the 'deviation >20%' condition is always true.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Time Domain Analysis
units.does: Claims time-domain metrics need >=10 clean RR and include meanRR, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, SDSD, HR stats and triangular index with 7.8125 ms bins. Code: computeTimeDomain guards cleanRR.count >= 10 (TimeDomainAnalysis.swift:227); computeTriangularIndex uses 7.8125 ms bins and needs >=20 beats (MinimumBeats.forTriangularIndex).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Frequency Domain Analysis
units.does: Claims 4 Hz cubic-spline resampling, Welch 256-sample Hann segments with 50% overlap and per-segment linear detrend, VLF/LF/HF bands 0.003-0.04/0.04-0.15/0.15-0.4 Hz, VLF only for windows >=10 min via its own 1024-sample Welch pass, single zero-padded periodogram for short windows. Code matches: resampleFrequency=4.0, defaultWelchSegmentLength=256, vlfWelchSegmentLength=1024, vlfMinDuration = minimumVLFWindowMinutes(5)*2, Hann via vDSP_hann_windowD, linearlyDetrended, computeSingleWindowPSD.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > DFA Analysis
units.does: Claims DFA integrates (RR-mean), uses log-spaced boxes 4..N/4, linear detrend per box, log-log slope; alpha1 boxes 4-16, alpha2 16-64 requiring >=256 beats; overnight DFA (NonlinearAnalyzer and each WindowSelector candidate) interpolates removed beats (artifact, or in selection also ectopic/out of range) and splits at recording breaks with no box across a split, boxes up to a quarter of the longest segment; SD1 from the same adjacent pairs as RMSSD/SDSD; entropy templates inside runs of neighbours; alpha1 bands 0.75-1.0 organized, 0.6-0.75 flexible, >1.0 high variability, <0.6 anti-correlated; bands drive window selection and a +/-5 Tier-1 adjustment; Tools/copy_linter blocks verdict language. Code matches: DFAAnalyzer.compute(segments:) returns nil below 64 beats, maxBox = longest segment/4, alpha2Exponent requires forDFA=256; DFAAnalyzer.compute(window:)/interpolatedSegments; WindowSelector.scoredBlock and NonlinearAnalyzer.metrics(for:successiveDifferences:) call it; RecoveryWindow.optimalAlpha1Range 0.75...1.0, flexible 0.60...0.75; dfaAlpha1Adjustment +5; Tools/copy_linter/prohibited_terms.json lists the 'gold standard'/'load-bearing' patterns.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Stress Analysis
units.does: Claims Baevsky SI = AMo/(2*Mo*MxDMn) with 50 ms bins; PNS = mean z of meanRR(926), RMSSD(42), SD1(29); SNS = mean z of meanHR(66), SI(100), inverted SD2(65); readiness 1-10 starting at 5 with RMSSD ratio bands (+2/+1/-2/0) against the 60-night geometric baseline; until it exists RRCollector.ansConfig falls back to settings.baselineRMSSD then UserSettings.populationBaselineRMSSD (35 ms with no age), so every app reading uses the ratio; the VO2max-adjusted absolute bands run only when no ANSConfiguration is passed (HRVAnalysisPipeline.readinessScore passes config?.baselineRMSSD) or the baseline is <= 0; alpha1 +2/+0.5/-1, PNS-SNS +1.5/+0.5/-0.5/-1.5, hard training adds back the negative load adjustment, clamp [1,10]. Constants match StressNormativeConstants.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Respiration Rate Estimation
units.does: Claims respiration rate is spectral only: RR resampled to 4 Hz, FFT, HF-band peak → breaths/min, needs ≥ 60 RR intervals, reported only when the peak is breathing (≥ 40 % of the band's power within ±0.02 Hz, ≥ 5 % of the strongest peak above 0.04 Hz), 6-40 sanity check. Matches RespirationAnalyzer.estimateRespirationRate and isBreathingPeak.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Analysis Algorithms > Diagnostic Scoring
units.does: Claims computeDiagnosticScore starts at 50 and clamps to [0,100] with RMSSD category points (+40/+30/+20/+10/-10, personal ratio bands 1.15/0.85/0.70/0.60 or age-adjusted), stress index points (<100 +20, <150 +15, <200 +10, <300 0, else -15), LF/HF (0.5-2.0 +20, <0.5 +15, <=3.0 +5, else -10), alpha1 0.75-1.0 +20, ANS balance +15/+10/-5/-15; headline uses the Recovery Score with ScoreVerdict bands 90/75/60/45/30; action steps use 80/60/40; 60+ probable-cause factors. Point values and thresholds match code. The cause detectors (Analysis/CauseDetection) contain 37 DetectedCause construction sites; the '60+ factors' count is not established by code.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for window selection.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Core Principle: 30-70% of Actual Sleep
units.does: Claims window selection operates on the 30-70% band of actual sleep duration (HealthKit when available), not recording duration. Code: WindowSelector.Config minRelativePosition 0.30 / maxRelativePosition 0.70; resolveSleepBoundaries/findSearchBand use sleepStartMs/wakeTimeMs when supplied.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Selection Methods
units.does: Claims selection methods: consolidated (Tier-1 ranked organized windows, RMSSD fallback without a 60-night/min-3 baseline), peak RMSSD, peak SDNN, peak total power (SDNN proxy), custom tap 400-beat window ignoring the band. A custom window is a preview until Apply: ReanalysisService.applyManualAnalysis re-scores from it, sets windowUserAdjusted, keeps the auto pick (preserveAutoWindow -> autoWindowResult/autoWindowScore), and persistManualAnalysis archives with re-upload and calls BaselineTracker.update, so the stored score, later nights' baseline and trends use it; Cancel saves nothing.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Algorithm Steps
units.does: Claims config 400-beat window, 40-beat slide step, clean beats max(50,75%) capped at 300, stability weight 10; two-pass artifact rule 10% then 15%; adaptive sizing (>=400 full, 240-399 50%, <240 60% min 60, step max(10, size/10)); isolated-spike filter at 1.50x both neighbours with unfiltered fallback; classification by alpha1 and HR CV with LF/HF always nil; organized windows ranked by Tier-1 then RMSSD then position, nil if none. Code matches: Config beatsPerWindow 400, maxArtifactRateStrict 0.10, maxArtifactRate 0.15, minCleanBeats 300, stabilityWeight 10, isolatedSpikeRatio 1.50; computeAdaptiveWindowSize; scanBandWithArtifactFallback; selectOrganizedWindow uses allWindows when the spike filter empties the set; scoredBlock passes lfHfRatio nil. Config.slideStepBeats=40 is declared but never read; the step actually used is computeAdaptiveWindowSize's max(10, windowSize/10).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Window Classification
units.does: Claims isOrganizedRecovery = alpha1 in [0.75,1.0] and HR CV < 8% (LF/HF nil branch, the production path), tolerant LF/HF<=1.5-or-CV branch reachable only from tests, CV<8% alone without alpha1; flexible 0.60-0.75; high variability <0.6 or >1.0. Code matches ScoredRecoveryBlock.isOrganizedRecovery (unstableCVThreshold 0.08, maxOrganizedLfHf 1.5) and classification. Note classification() labels alpha1 0.75-1.0 as organizedRecovery without the CV test, unlike isOrganizedRecovery.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Peak Capacity
units.does: Claims peak capacity is computed independently as the highest sustained RMSSD regardless of organization and may exist without a consolidated window. Code: findBestWindowWithCapacity runs findPeakCapacity over the whole recording with the compact adaptive window.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Window Selection > Consolidation Score
units.does: Claims block score = rmssd * 1/(1 + stabilityWeight*hrCV). Code ScoredRecoveryBlock.recoveryScore also multiplies by an artifact factor max(0.5, 1 - 2.5*artifactRate).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation
units.does: Claims a three-tier ln(RMSSD) z-score composite computed on 0-100 and converted by RecoveryScoreCalculator.toTenScale (called from RRCollector+Analysis.swift) to a value stored on HRVSession.recoveryScore, described here as 1-10; training load is not in the composite. Code: MorningSessionPipeline.computeRecoveryScore in RRCollector+Analysis.swift:39 does call toTenScale; toTenScale is score/10 (Composite.swift:66) applied to a composite clamped to 0...100 (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:633), so the stored value is 0-10, as ARCHITECTURE.md:678 says, not 1-10.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Tier 1 — HRV Only (cold start, no sleep, no vitals)
units.does: Claims Tier 1: z of ln(RMSSD) vs 60-night baseline mapped by scoringParametersV2 bands (-3->5, -1.5->25, -0.75->64, -0.5..+0.5->72, +1.5->90); adjustments RHR clamp(zHR*-5,+/-10), DFA +5/-5(>1.2)/-3(<0.6), CV <2% -5 / >12% -3, ANS <-1.5 -6, <-0.5 -3, >=+1.5 +2, staleness >=7 days -5 growing 5/week capped 20; missing-sleep -10 when penalizeMissingSleep; fallback to readiness*10 then absolute RMSSD bands (60/45/30/20 -> 85/70/55/40/25, 50 with no HRV); window ranking excludes the ANS term. Code matches: zToRecoveryScore bands, RecoveryScoreConstants.HRVAdjustments, BaselineStaleness (staleAfterDays 7, penaltyPerWeek 5 * (1 + fractional weeks), maxPenalty 20), AbsoluteRMSSDFallback, missingSleepPenaltyApplies (tier 1 && enableSleepIntegration && penalizeMissingSleep && no sleep), rankByTier1Score passes no ansBalance.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Tier 2 — HRV + Sleep (sleep present, vitals absent)
units.does: Claims every night with sleep minutes (staged or not) gets SleepScienceAnalyzer's enhanced score as the sleep sub-score (duration 25, efficiency 20, deep+REM 20, continuity 15, cycles 10, architecture 10 points; half credit for unmeasured sections; duration-debt cap below 85% of target), and the weighted formula (zeroMinuteNightScore: duration 0.35 on 24 h sleep incl. naps, efficiency 0.25, deep and REM fixed at the neutral 0.5 with 0.25/0.15) runs only for zero-minute nights; composite tier1*0.70 + sleep*0.30, dampened to 0.85/0.15 when z_hrv < -1.0 and sleep < 50. Matches calculateSleepScore and ScoringWeights.Tier2/Sleep.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Tier 3 — HRV + Sleep + Vitals (full-signal day)
units.does: Claims Tier 3 vitals score = mean of available RHR (100 - 10 per SD above baseline, floor 0), RR (100 within +1 br/min of 7-day baseline, -15 per br/min beyond; population 12-18 -> 100, above -> -15/br, below 12 -> 90), wrist temperature vs 7-day personal baseline (positive deviation only: <=0.3 ->100, <=0.5 ->75, <=1.0 ->50, else 25; no baseline -> dropped); all-nil -> nil -> Tier 2; composite 0.60/0.25/0.15. Code matches calculateVitalsScore, restingHRSubScore (nil without HR baseline), respiratorySubScore, respiratoryPopulationScore, temperatureSubScore (max(0,dev)), wristTemperatureAgainstPersonalBaseline (nil deviation without baseline), ScoringWeights.Tier3, buildTier3.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Comeback mode
units.does: Claims comeback mode (comebackModeStartDate, Settings -> Modes) shifts Tier 3 weights to 0.80/0.20/0.00 for 21 days via computed UserSettings.isComebackModeActive with no auto-clear. Code: ScoringWeights.Comeback 0.80/0.20/0.0, ScoreDetailBuilder.tier3Weights(comebackModeActive:), isComebackModeActive computed (UserSettings+Model.swift:350); the toggle appears in ModesSettingsPage.swift (and TrainingSettingsPage.swift references the date).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Vitals overrides (post-composite, all tiers)
units.does: Claims only SpO2 keeps a post-composite penalty: 24-h average SpO2 < 95% -> -10; constants centralised in ScoringWeights (Constants.swift) and RecoveryScoreConstants (Constants+RecoveryScore.swift). Code matches: fetchOxygenSaturation uses a 24-h discreteAverage window; RecoveryVitals.isSpO2Concerning = spo2 < 95; applyVitalsOverrides subtracts RecoveryScoreConstants.Vitals.spo2Penalty (10). RecoveryScoreConstants.Vitals still declares respiratoryPenalty and temperature penalties for the removed post-composite rules.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Confidence pips (cold-start UX)
units.does: Claims a three-stage confidence pip (0-13 building and score hidden, 14-27 provisional, 28+ full) from BaselineTracker.daysCollected; z-scoring starts at BaselineTracker.RecoveryBaselineStats.minimumDays (3); ScoreAppearancePolicy (DashboardSessionPolicy.swift) holds scoreShownNights=14 and fullBaselineNights=28; implemented in ConfidencePip.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Recovery Score Calculation > Score feedback
units.does: Claims no screen asks the user to rate the score; RecoveryScoreFeedbackStore (App Group Feedback/recovery_score_feedback.json) is never read into scoring and is cleared by Delete all my data. Code: RecoveryScoreFeedbackStore header states no screen records entries; its only non-DI reference is DataPurgeService (clearAll).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation
units.does: Claims training readiness is a separate 0-100 score modulated by the recovery score. Code: ReadinessScoring.calculateReadiness returns 0-100 after ACWR modifier, freshness bonus and recovery modulation.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation > Capacity Ratio Model
units.does: Claims acuteFatigue = sum TRIMP*0.30*exp(-h/24) over the last 72 h (today's TRIMP*0.35 without them); effectiveLoad = ATL + acute; ratio = effectiveLoad/CTL when CTL>=3.2, piecewise 0->100, 0.8->85, 1.0->70, 1.3->50, 1.5->30, 2.0+->10; below CTL 3.2 readiness = max(10, 100 - (ATL + undamped acute)*0.5). Code matches computeAcuteFatigue, computeBaseReadiness, mapCapacityRatioToReadiness and RecoveryScoreConstants.Readiness.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation > ACWR Modifier (Training Readiness only — NOT the recovery score)
units.does: Claims ACWR modifier on readiness only: no effect 0.8-1.3, >1.3 penalty min(5% + (ACWR-1.3)*50%, 40%), no detraining penalty, multiplied by min(CTL/50,1), capped at 10% when recovery >= 70; ACWR not named in user copy per system-prompt rules 11 and 13. Code matches applyACWRModifier/dampenedACWRPenalty and AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift rules 11 (line 103) and 13 (line 119). RecoveryScoreConstants.Readiness still declares acwrDetrainingThreshold/PenaltySlope/PenaltyCap, which nothing reads.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation > Fatigue Dissipation (intra-day)
units.does: Claims rest-day ATL drop raises readiness by 1.5 points per ATL unit, capped at 20 (applyFreshnessBonus). Code matches (freshnessGainMultiplier 1.5, freshnessGainCap 20, only when morningATL > 0).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation > Recovery Modulation
units.does: Claims asymmetric recovery modulation: above recovery keep recovery + gap*min(CTL/40,1)*0.55; below, give back 30% of the gap. Code matches applyRecoveryModulation (modelTrustDivisor 40, modelTrustCeiling 0.55, recoveryUpliftFraction 0.30).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Training Readiness Calculation > Key Difference from Recovery Score
units.does: Claims recovery score is 0-100 from HRV 60/Sleep 25/Vitals 15 with SpO2 post-penalty, fixed at morning; training readiness listed as 0-10 from capacity ratio, strain and dampened ACWR, live through the day. Code: calculateReadiness returns 0-100 (the section heading at line 447 also says 0-100); screens convert with toTenScale/tenScaleClamped.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the sleep pipeline.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline > Sleep Boundary Resolution
units.does: Claims a fallback chain HealthKit sleep -> HR estimate from RR -> recording boundaries, and that MorningResultsView writes longer fresh HealthKit boundaries via updateSessionSleepBoundaries (clamped to the recording) without uploading them to iCloud. Code: SleepBoundaryResolver.resolve; ReanalysisService.updateSessionSleepBoundaries clamps newStartMs with max(0, ...) and archives with requestingReupload only for user adjustments; CloudSessionPayload.uploadable nils sleepSnapshot before upload.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline > Sleep Query Window
units.does: Claims fetchSleepData(for:recordingEnd:rrPoints:autoSleepExtension:) queries the recording's own boundaries with no display-vs-analysis switch; extendForDisplay does not exist; only a supplied autoSleepExtension widens the query. Code: fetchSleepData exists in SleepHealthQueries/HealthKitManager; no 'extendForDisplay' symbol exists in Swift sources; SleepMergingPipeline.processForRecording defaults autoSleepExtension to nil.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline > HRV Sleep Stage Classification
units.does: Claims two-path staging 'in SleepMergingPipeline': path 1 augments Watch stages with RR features per 5-minute epoch when augmentation is enabled, repainting only overridden epochs; path 2 classifies from RR alone when no Watch stages, needing >=100 RR points and valid boundaries; enableHRVSleepAugmentation controls only augmentation. Code: SleepMergingPipeline.processForRecording delegates to SleepResolver.resolve; SleepResolver.maybeAugment guards ctx.enhanceWithRR && rrPoints.count>=100 and returns the Watch intervals with only overridden epochs; inferStagesFromRR requires >=100 points and does not read the toggle, anchoring at SleepBoundaryResolver.detectSleepOnset.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline > Sleep Science Analysis
units.does: Claims SleepScienceAnalyzer computes fragmentation index, NREM->REM cycles, architecture front/back-loading, age-adjusted norms, and an enhanced 0-100 score used by Tier 2 'when stage data available'. SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze returns an analysis (and enhancedScore) for any night with sleep minutes > 0, including nights without stages (see Tier 2 record).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Sleep Pipeline > HR-Estimated Sleep (fallback, not extension)
units.does: Claims when HealthKit has zero sleep, MorningResultsViewModel.estimateSleepFallback tries the RR-derived estimate (estimateSleepFromHR) then passive Watch HR (estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR over the window extended to the schedule end); passive algorithm: 20-min rolling average, >=8 BPM range, threshold at range midpoint, onset = first 2 consecutive points below threshold, accepted only within a 20-min wall-clock latency, else bedtime (a later detection is a misfire), wake = end of last below-threshold block; minimumSamples 12, minimumSleepMinutes 120; AutoSleepExtension is never constructed outside SleepResolverTests; DashboardViewModel/WatchSleepDetector do not exist. Code matches: estimateSleepFallback (MorningResultsViewModel.swift:488), smoothHRSamples(windowMinutes: 20) at HealthKitManager+Sleep.swift:418, hrSleepThreshold, plausibleSleepOnset (SleepConstants.isPlausibleHROnsetLatency), sleepWake, estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR(minimumSamples: 12, minimumSleepMinutes: 120); grep finds AutoSleepExtension( only in EmuquTests/SleepResolverTests.swift; no DashboardViewModel or checkForExtendedSleep in Swift sources.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Baseline & Trends
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for baselines and trends.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Baseline & Trends > 7-Day Rolling Baseline
units.does: Claims a 7-day rolling baseline (min 3 samples, max 90 stored points) over RMSSD, SDNN, meanHR, HF, LF, LF/HF, alpha1, stress index, readiness; admission only for HRV-reliable overnight sessions; one slot per night keyed by SleepSchedule.nightKey; a morning reading (ending no later than expected wake + 4 h) beats a non-morning one, else the newcomer must pass consolidation/organized/artifact/HR-stability gates and be >5% better. Code matches: baselineWindowDays 7, Baseline.minimumSamples 3, maxHistoricalPoints 90, admitsToBaseline rejects non-overnight, mergeIntoNight/shouldReplace use isMorningReading (morningCutoff = firstWake + 4 h), newWindowIsObjectivelyBetter and isMeaningfullyBetterScore (minimumImprovementFraction).

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Baseline & Trends > 60-Night Recovery Baseline
units.does: Claims recovery baseline lnRmssdMean/SD over historicalData.suffix(60) (night count), 7-day CV, HR mean/SD, minimum 3 nights, SD widened below 7 nights (~1.53x at 3), and scoring uses recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:sleepSchedule:) restricted to earlier night keys while the plain property is for display. Code matches BaselineTracker.stats (suffix(60), minimumDays 3), widenedLnSD (confidenceFloor 7), sevenDayCV (needs >=7 points), recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:) filter nightKey < night.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Storage & Sync
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for storage and sync.

units.key: § Emuqu — Architecture & Algorithms > Storage & Sync > Session Archive
units.does: Claims file-based JSON archive in the App Group with SHA256 integrity, an in-memory SessionArchiveEntry index with sortedEntriesCache, NSLock archiveLock with 3-phase migrations, and retrieveLightweight decoding with skipRRSeries.
